title: Vignette 2026-10-29: pointing at a specific element, both ways

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-29, answering whether this is the current attention: "When I'm working in the editor, I need to be able to point at a specific element. Sometimes I don't want general comments, I want to be specific. So I need to be able to highlight an element of my essay.

In reverse, I also need an agent to be able to point at something specific. It may be valuable to allow a comment to highlight specfic words in a paragraph. This will allow us to be direct. (I should be able to dismiss a highlighty via the comment too) I need to be able to see what comment links to what highlight"
